tag_minions.name: TAG Assassins
tag_minions.notes: TAG Scene 10: d3+2 agents, HCL+2 minions. Streetwise L5 may avert the fight before the medusa scene.

tag_minions.name: White Gargoyles
tag_minions.notes: TAG Scene 8: d6+2 L5 white gargoyle minions. Check surprise; escape is blocked until the printed outnumber/flying/teleport conditions are met. Bounty is 15 gp per head.

tag_minions.name: Silent Scream Cultists
tag_minions.notes: TAG Scene 16: nine L3 Silent Scream chaos-cultist minions accompany the priestess in the final shrine.

tag_minions.name: TAG Bandits
tag_minions.notes: TAG Bandit Hideout: d6+2 L4 bandits protect the chieftain. Used as the exact bandit-guard spawn in TAG generated adventures.

tag_minions.name: Gorungar's Goblin Archers

on_hit_effects.description: Poison arrows: wounded heroes save vs L4 poison or suffer the printed TAG poison consequence.

tag_minions.notes: TAG Gorungar the Mighty: 2d6 goblin archers at HCL+1, shooting as HCL+3, morale -1, poison arrows L4.

tag_minions.name: Young Minotaurs

encounter_start_effects.description: Charge: first attack is made at HCL+4 by TAG Minotaur Maze rules.

tag_minions.notes: TAG Minotaur Maze: d6 young minotaurs, HCL+3 minions, morale +1, treasure -1; first charge attacks at HCL+4 and they prefer halfling targets.

tag_weird.name: Adult Minotaur
tag_weird.notes: TAG Minotaur Maze: HCL+4 Weird Monster, 4 Life, 2 attacks. First Defense against it is at -1; halflings cannot use Luck against it.

tag_boss.name: Mutant Fish
tag_boss.notes: TAG Scene 12: mutant fish under the bridge. Surviving party gains d6+3 food rations and the scene counts as two minion encounters for XP.

tag_boss.name: Silent Scream Priestess
tag_boss.notes: TAG Scene 16: chaos priestess Boss HCL+3 with HCL+2 Life, accompanied by nine Silent Scream cultists. Printed reward is 150 gp plus XP.

tag_boss.name: Hill Giant

encounter_start_effects.description: First turn boulder: 4-in-6 chance to hurl a boulder for 3 damage by TAG Giant's Lair rules.

tag_boss.notes: TAG Giant's Lair: HCL+2 Boss, 8 Life, 2 attacks for 2 damage, targets dwarves if present. Spells hit at +2. Treasure: 3 rolls and double gp; fights to death.

tag_boss.name: Minotaur Lord
tag_boss.notes: TAG Minotaur Maze final boss: HCL+5 Weird-style foe, 6 Life, 2 attacks, treasure +1. First Defense is at -1; damage scales by Tier; halflings cannot use Luck.

tag_boss.name: Bandit Chieftain
tag_boss.notes: TAG Bandit Hideout final boss: HCL+4, 6 Life, 4 attacks, protected by d6+2 L4 bandits. Treasure is 8d6 gp plus a random magic item. Capture alive for bounty or a free rumor.

tag_boss.name: Gorungar the Mighty
tag_boss.notes: TAG minor quest: HCL+5 Boss, 8 Life, 2 attacks, with 2d6 goblin archers. Reward is 50 gp for his head or 100 gp alive, plus armband and coin bag.

tag_boss.name: Griffin
tag_boss.notes: TAG Griffin Omelets, Anyone?: flying nest guardian used for the generated guild-job finale. Resolve egg handling and exact rewards from the printed quest.

tag_boss.name: Red Portrait Horror
tag_boss.notes: TAG A Portrait in Red: supernatural portrait threat for the generated guild-job finale. Use printed scene text for exact non-combat choices.

tag_boss.name: Monoceros

encounter_start_effects.description: Charging horn attack: apply the printed Monoceros Hunt opening attack if used at the table.

tag_boss.notes: TAG Monoceros Hunt: wilderness hunt finale. Track pursuit and printed reward manually.
